name: v0.3.62 — Introducing GuacMoney 🥑
releaseNotes:
• GuacMoney is here — earn points for using GetGuac (1,000 GuacMoney = $1). +100 every receipt you scan, +1,000 for every friend you refer.
• Your GuacMoney balance shows on the dashboard as a coin pill that counts up.
• Scan a receipt and watch a “+100 GuacMoney” celebration flash, Fetch-style.
• New GuacMoney screen: balance, progress to your next reward, and how to earn (redeem for gift cards — coming soon).
• Refer a friend + GuacMoney added to the Menu; notification bell now shows a badge.
